answer.text: Five years of capital requests, each ranked by the Capital Planning Committee: between 37.7% and 68.9% of the dollars requested were funded, and in 3 years the money did not follow the committee’s order.

blocks.alt: Every capital request the committee ranked, in each year’s order, then the requests it never ranked, with lines joining the same project across years.

label.text: ranked on the five lists, all drawn
on the lists in two or more years

so.text: A dashed line is our join, by name; where the town’s number joins two years the line is solid.

claims.text: Of 142 ranked requests on the five lists, 17 projects came back in a later year.

label.text: unfunded the first year, funded on a later list
on two or more lists and never funded in these years

so.text: One year’s outcome was not the last word on those projects.

claims.text: 9 were unfunded the first time and funded later; 6 never were.

label.text: requested and never ranked, five years
never ranked, with a reason a document or recording states

so.text: At least, because the departments’ own lists are not held; the rest were found in minutes, decks and recordings.

claims.text: At least 23 more requests were made and never ranked; 18 of 23 have a stated reason.
